nao.label: NAO
nao.note: North Atlantic Oscillation. CPC-style pattern applied to the member's 500 hPa height anomaly; annual standard deviations.

pna.label: PNA
pna.note: Pacific / North American. CPC-style pattern applied to the member's 500 hPa height anomaly; annual standard deviations.

ao.label: Arctic Oscillation
ao.note: First EOF of sea-level pressure poleward of 20°N; positive = low pressure over the pole.

ea.label: East Atlantic
ea.note: East Atlantic. CPC-style pattern applied to the member's 500 hPa height anomaly; annual standard deviations.

wp.label: West Pacific
wp.note: West Pacific. CPC-style pattern applied to the member's 500 hPa height anomaly; annual standard deviations.

epnp.label: East Pacific / North Pacific
epnp.note: East Pacific / North Pacific. CPC-style pattern applied to the member's 500 hPa height anomaly; annual standard deviations.

eawr.label: East Atlantic / West Russia
eawr.note: East Atlantic / West Russia. CPC-style pattern applied to the member's 500 hPa height anomaly; annual standard deviations.

sca.label: Scandinavia
sca.note: Scandinavia. CPC-style pattern applied to the member's 500 hPa height anomaly; annual standard deviations.

tnh.label: Tropical / Northern Hemisphere
tnh.note: Tropical / Northern Hemisphere. CPC-style pattern applied to the member's 500 hPa height anomaly; annual standard deviations.

pol.label: Polar / Eurasia
pol.note: Polar / Eurasia. CPC-style pattern applied to the member's 500 hPa height anomaly; annual standard deviations.

epo.label: EPO
epo.note: Eastern Pacific Oscillation. CPC-style pattern applied to the member's 500 hPa height anomaly; annual standard deviations.

wpo.label: WPO
wpo.note: Western Pacific Oscillation. CPC-style pattern applied to the member's 500 hPa height anomaly; annual standard deviations.

soi.label: Southern Oscillation index
soi.note: Tahiti minus Darwin sea-level pressure, standardised by the hindcast spread at each lead; negative with El Niño.

u60n10.label: 60°N 10 hPa zonal wind
u60n10.note: Zonal-mean zonal wind, the standard vortex-strength metric; below zero is an easterly (reversed) vortex.

u60s10.label: 60°S 10 hPa zonal wind
u60s10.note: Zonal-mean zonal wind, the standard vortex-strength metric; below zero is an easterly (reversed) vortex.

qbo10.label: QBO: equatorial 10 hPa wind
qbo10.note: 5°S–5°N zonal-mean zonal wind, SEAS5's own QBO; westerly positive.

qbo30.label: QBO: equatorial 30 hPa wind
qbo30.note: 5°S–5°N zonal-mean zonal wind, SEAS5's own QBO; westerly positive.

qbo50.label: QBO: equatorial 50 hPa wind
qbo50.note: 5°S–5°N zonal-mean zonal wind, SEAS5's own QBO; westerly positive.

nam10.label: NAM at 10 hPa
nam10.note: Polar-cap (65–90°N) height anomaly, standardised by the hindcast and sign-flipped: positive = strong vortex / low polar heights.

nam50.label: NAM at 50 hPa
nam50.note: Polar-cap (65–90°N) height anomaly, standardised by the hindcast and sign-flipped: positive = strong vortex / low polar heights.

nam100.label: NAM at 100 hPa
nam100.note: Polar-cap (65–90°N) height anomaly, standardised by the hindcast and sign-flipped: positive = strong vortex / low polar heights.

nam500.label: NAM at 500 hPa
nam500.note: Polar-cap (65–90°N) height anomaly, standardised by the hindcast and sign-flipped: positive = strong vortex / low polar heights.

nam1000.label: NAM at 1000 hPa
nam1000.note: Polar-cap (65–90°N) height anomaly, standardised by the hindcast and sign-flipped: positive = strong vortex / low polar heights.

wave1_100.label: Wave-1 amplitude, 100 hPa, 60°N
wave1_100.note: Amplitude of the zonal wavenumber along 60°N: the planetary-wave forcing that precedes a warming.

wave2_100.label: Wave-2 amplitude, 100 hPa, 60°N
wave2_100.note: Amplitude of the zonal wavenumber along 60°N: the planetary-wave forcing that precedes a warming.
